recognize_zh: 低倍下有核細胞極多，幾乎全是各成熟階段的粒細胞系（前髓細胞、髓細胞、後髓細胞、帶狀及分節嗜中性球），以髓細胞為主峰，母細胞不多，並可見嗜鹼性球；這種「髓細胞高峰、無母細胞增加」的全階段粒細胞增生，是慢性骨髓性白血病慢性期（CML-CP）的典型樣貌。
features: Markedly increased granulocytic cells spanning all stages of maturation
Myelocytes and metamyelocytes predominate (myelocyte peak), with numerous bands and segmented neutrophils
Blasts not increased; few scattered cells with finer chromatin only
Erythroid precursors relatively sparse (increased M:E ratio)
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (Wright-Giemsa, low power) is markedly cellular and dominated by granulocytic cells at all stages of maturation, with a predominance of myelocytes and metamyelocytes and numerous bands and segmented neutrophils. Scattered basophils and eosinophils are present, erythroid precursors are relatively reduced, and blasts do not appear increased. Megakaryocytes are not assessable in this field. Findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia, BCR::ABL1-positive, in chronic phase, as confirmed by FISH and PCR.

ddx.vs: Reactive states show a peak of segmented neutrophils and bands with toxic granulation and Döhle bodies, without basophilia or a myelocyte peak, and are BCR::ABL1-negative.
aCML has prominent granulocytic dysplasia (hypogranular, pseudo-Pelger neutrophils) without significant basophilia and lacks BCR::ABL1, often with SETBP1/ASXL1 mutations.
CNL shows mature segmented neutrophils making up at least 80% of WBC with immature granulocytes under 10%, and CSF3R mutation rather than a myelocyte peak.
Advanced phases show increased blasts (10-19% or at least 20%), basophils at least 20%, or blast clusters, which are not seen here.
